start_here: Say to your AI: "Sign my proof accounts in with the codes you kept." It runs tool:sign-the-proof-accounts-in-with-their-kept-codes.
no_lists_because: Its only state is vault values (proof-sessions, proof-sign-in-code), never rows; the proof accounts are the Workshop DATA proof-accounts.json.
instructions: 1. Step keep has put the codes in proof-sign-in-code.
2. Run the tool with no input.

3. Each code is exchanged at its site; a session is kept only when the site's get-session names the proof account. The sessions go into proof-sessions and the code value is marked spent. The answer gives each origin's signed_in, cookie names and ends.
